name: DevOps CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Verify HTML File
        run: |
          echo "Checking project files..."
          ls
          test -f index.html

      - name: Build Application
        run: |
          echo "Building web application..."
          echo "Build completed successfully."

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          echo "Running tests..."
          test -f index.html
          echo "Tests passed successfully."

      - name: Generate Build Logs
        run: |
          echo "Build completed at:"
          date

      - name: Slack Success Notification
        if: success()
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
          -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data '{"text":"✅ CI Pipeline SUCCESS - devops-webapp"}' \
          "${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}"

      - name: Slack Failure Notification
        if: failure()
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
          -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data '{"text":"❌ CI Pipeline FAILED - devops-webapp"}' \
          "${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}"
